Simplified Stage 1–2 MUTCD problem-discovery test. Work only within these six inspection domains: ["lane_closure_layout", "advance_warning_sign_system", "channelization_system", "transition_and_taper_geometry", "conditional_active_devices", "conditional_termination_area"]. The goal is a small, clear set of executable field inspection checks that can reveal distinct work-zone problems; the goal is not to reproduce every applicable manual clause or any hidden checklist shape. No target IDs, target citations, or target count are supplied.

Stage 1 has three transparent layers. Call load_ta_core_graph once. Then call load_scene_condition_graph once. Then call load_domain_gap_candidates once for each of the six domains; the configured Stage 1C method is BM25 retrieval over normative atomic provisions. The program performs ranking, candidate limiting, paging, and project-scope filtering internally. After all six domain calls, begin requirement registration. Do not run free-form searches and do not build or close a candidate ledger. After all six domain calls, begin requirement registration. The six-domain framework is a coverage guide, not a list of answers: {"lane_closure_layout": {"purpose": "overall lane-closure configuration and traffic-path redirection", "review_dimensions": ["Typical Application context", "transition mechanism", "closed-lane-side channelization placement"]}, "advance_warning_sign_system": {"purpose": "the advance-warning system shown or implied by the selected layout", "review_dimensions": ["sign use/presence", "legend and closure-direction consistency", "placement relative to the work/closure", "encounter sequence", "spacing applicability"]}, "channelization_system": {"purpose": "the channelizing-device system that defines the transition and closed lane", "review_dimensions": ["spacing in each alignment type", "condition and maintenance", "response to no-longer-serviceable devices"]}, "transition_and_taper_geometry": {"purpose": "the operational function and geometry of the merging transition", "review_dimensions": ["driver warning/merge adequacy", "length criteria and formula applicability"]}, "conditional_active_devices": {"purpose": "active devices only when their presence is established by scene facts", "review_dimensions": ["device applicability", "permitted operating mode/direction", "placement and integration with other TTC devices"]}, "conditional_termination_area": {"purpose": "termination controls only when their physical predicate is established", "review_dimensions": ["downstream taper", "termination signing"]}}

Stage 2 compiles retrieved provisions into the complete set of distinct, currently applicable field inspection predicates. Use submit_inspection_check_batch. Do not optimize for a target count. Register every applicable predicate that can be violated independently; shared evidence, a shared measurement tool, or related subject matter is not by itself a reason to merge predicates. Combine branches only when they are inseparable conditions or thresholds of the same compliance decision. Preserve the canonical shall/should modality supplied by the program and keep a concrete MUTCD source. A true component-presence fact activates provisions whose antecedent is that the component is used, even when the later compliance observation is unknown. It does not establish a narrower antecedent requiring a particular mode, state, roadway condition, or configuration. Unknown or false presence facts do not activate a family. Exclude pavement markings; buffer and activity area; positive protection and attenuators; nighttime visibility; pedestrian, bicycle, and accessibility; opposing-direction-only layouts; material/crashworthiness certification; sign mounting height; and device product construction or capability specifications. Do not include a general manual statement unless it can produce a distinct field finding in this scene. Semantic duplicates expressing the same subject, condition, relation, threshold, and modality should be merged; requirements that differ on any of those dimensions remain separate. Non-optional components of the selected Typical Application may serve as Guidance sources when the returned node carries a normative_basis from the manual. After the initial compilation, call audit_stage2_candidate_coverage. Review every returned deterministic KG candidate with submit_stage2_candidate_decision_batch. For each candidate explicitly state whether its activation antecedent is established, whether it can be violated independently, whether it duplicates another predicate, and retain or exclude it with a reason. The program binds canonical predicate text and source provenance and directly registers retained decisions. Submit a decision for every pending candidate. Then call the audit again; seal only when new_candidate_count and pending_structured_decision_count are both zero. Mark all six regions screened, seal registration, and stop immediately after Stage 2.
